 US News Agregar Clarín en X How many endings does GTA 6 have? What decides your finale and how the post-game works
 Grand Theft Auto 6 ditches the simple final-mission choice menu of GTA IV and GTA V in favor of a dynamic conclusion shaped by your entire playthrough. 
 With at least four endings discovered so far—and Rockstar confirming "a lot more than two"—everything from Jason and Lucia's romance to your bank account determines how the story wraps up. 
 Here is a spoiler-free breakdown of how many endings GTA 6 has, the four factors that control them, and how free roam works after the credits roll.
 GTA 6 relationship system guide: How romance works, and how to boost or ruin Jason and Lucia’s bond 
 How the Criminal Profile works in GTA 6: Karma and honor system explained 
 With at least four endings discovered so far—and Rockstar confirming "a lot more than two"—everything from Jason and Lucia's romance to your bank account determines how the story in GTA 6 wraps up. NEWSROOM CLARIN Grand Theft Auto 6 has at least four distinct endings discovered by players and reviewers so far, with Rockstar Games confirming that the campaign features "a lot more than two" possible conclusions.
 Unlike GTA IV (which forced a binary Deal or Revenge choice) or GTA V (which handed players a three-option menu right before the final mission), GTA 6 does not rely on a single last-minute decision . Instead, the finale is built organically from how you play across the entire 45-to-115-hour campaign .
 Rockstar has also emphasized that there is no "good" or "bad" ending—every outcome is designed as a complete, tailored conclusion to your specific version of Jason and Lucia's story.
 The 4 factors that decide your GTA 6 ending
 According to Rockstar and early playthrough reports, four core systems track your behavior throughout Leonida and determine which finale you unlock:
 Narrative Choices: Key story decisions made hours earlier—such as whether you spare or kill certain characters, or whether you tackle a major job solo versus bringing your partner along—ripple forward and alter how missions and the final act unfold.
 Jason and Lucia's Relationship: You can play the duo as a deeply committed romantic couple or keep them strictly as platonic partners in crime. Going on dates, showing affection, checking in on each other, and committing crimes together directly shape their bond and final fate.
 Criminal Profile: Both Jason and Lucia build separate reputations based on how cleanly or recklessly you operate. The game tracks five distinct profile levels—Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable—which influence both the narrative and how quickly your Focus bar fills.
 Family Savings Account: Money carries real narrative weight in GTA 6. How much cash you invest and set aside in the couple's savings for a fresh start—versus blowing it all across Vice City—heavily influences specific endings.
 How the finale and post-game work after the credits
 Rockstar handles the post-game in GTA 6 differently than in GTA V or Red Dead Redemption 2, ensuring you never lose access to Leonida after finishing the story.
 The Point-of-No-Return Prompt: Before launching the multi-mission finale, the game explicitly asks if you are ready to proceed with the end of the story.
 The Post-Credits Rewind: Once you finish the finale and watch the credits roll, GTA 6 rewinds time back to the exact moment right before that final prompt. This time, Jason and Lucia decide they aren't ready yet and head back out into Vice City.
 Replaying the Finale: Because the game drops you back just before the climax, the finale mission marker remains active on your map. You can continue exploring in free roam and trigger the final sequence again whenever you want to chase a different outcome.
 What unlocks after beating GTA 6
 Finishing the main story is only the halfway mark for completionists, as rolling the credits opens up two major endgame features:
 Full 100% Completion Checklist: During the campaign, your completion percentage only tracks story missions. Once you finish the finale, the full completion menu unlocks—revealing massive post-game targets including 280 standout vehicles, 130 unique weapon variants, and 8 gym memberships.
 Cheats Menu: Beating the story unlocks the dedicated Cheats tab in the Progress menu, allowing you to complete specific challenges to activate cheat codes across Leonida.
 Editor's Tip: While you can replay the finale after the credits, GTA 6 does not include a standard mission replay feature for earlier story chapters . If you want to test dramatically different story branches without starting a brand-new save, make use of the game's 15 manual save slots at the start of each chapter.
